remarks:
Great investment opportunity featuring a two-bedroom, two-unit property with strong potential and plenty of upside. Each apartment offers a functional layout ready for your vision, making this an ideal chance for an investor or owner-occupant looking to add value. The property does need some TLC, but the bones and structure provide a solid foundation to build on.

Located in a quiet, well-established neighborhood, this home offers a peaceful setting while still being conveniently close to shopping, local businesses, restaurants, and everyday amenities. The surrounding area is well-situated for both renters and long-term occupancy, adding to its overall appeal as an income-producing property.

Outside, you’ll find a nice yard with space for outdoor enjoyment, gardening, or future improvements. Whether you’re looking to renovate and rent, live in one unit and lease the other, or add to your investment portfolio, this property offers flexibility, location, and opportunity all in one.
